Emma / Logan / Priyom — I reviewed Sage's MSA v4 redline. High-level legal positions and proposed language we plan to send as a counter (summary below). I can produce a tracked copy if you want the exact markup.

Key points:
- Data residency: We cannot accept a blanket "US-only" restriction for all processing unless the deployment model is a Dedicated/VPC instance. Proposed compromise: add an Appendix (Exhibit G) that requires US-only storage and processing for customer-controlled instances or when Sage purchases the Private deployment add-on. For Hosted accounts, we offer contractual commitments to US regions but need a carveout for short-term failover to other regions for capacity reasons.

- Liability cap: 2x fees is higher than our standard. We propose 1x fees (12-month lookback) or $2M whichever is greater. For customers with procured dedicated capacity we can entertain a higher cap tied to a committed spend band.

- SLA and credits: We will accept a clearer definition for tail latency credits but need to keep exclusions for scheduled maintenance, force majeure, and third-party infra failures. Suggest adding a measurement window and an aggregated monthly credit cap (e.g., max 30% of monthly fees).

- Term: Rolling 24 months is operationally tricky. Recommend either: (a) 12-month firm term with an automatic renewal unless terminated with 60 days' notice; or (b) 18-month term as commercial compromise. Priyom to advise.

- IP/OSS carveouts and indemnity: We will keep our standard IP indemnity and add explicit carveouts for open-source model components. Also tighten audit scope to reasonable frequency and notice.

I'll prepare a tracked MSA with the above positions and a redline summary (one-page) to accompany it. If Sage confirms they can accept a Dedicated/VPC option for US-only residency that would materially change our willingness on cap and term.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks for the visibility. A few commercial proposals from our side to help close quickly: 

1) Term / Rate trade: We can offer an 18-month committed term with the +25% capacity uplift at the proposed rate if Sage accepts a 10% credit on the first two months of uplift usage (applied as a one-time credit on first invoice post-uplift). Alternatively, a 12-month term keeps your pricing but reduces the credit.

2) Liability cap: If Sage proceeds with a Dedicated/VPC option (exhibit purchase), we can increase the cap to 2x fees (or $4M floor). For Hosted, standard 1x fees stands.

3) Order form mechanics: We'll add an Exhibit E that captures the uplift schedule, prorations, and billing cadence (monthly in arrears). Please confirm the desired effective date so we can calculate pro-rates.

4) Timeline: We can accept Laura's legal counter and aim to produce a consolidated redline by Aug 8. If Sage confirms Dedicated/VPC interest we can fast-track legal review.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call with procurement if that moves things faster.
